title: Tecnópata · Bip y el HUD de dron
description: Aitor's own ánima (docs/animas/tecnopata/): with Tecnópata on, Bip, a little floating drone, hovers by his shoulder (src/bip.ts), and his dock turns into a drone's HUD (cyan on dark glass, cut corners, scan lines) over the backdrop of Gerard's ánima. Atacar is Bip's: it darts at the dog and rams it while Aitor stays put pointing. Switching to another ánima, Bip comes apart into cyan nanites that stream into Aitor's chest; switching back, it comes out of him and forms again. Two players (the keyboard is Gerard, pad 2 Aitor), the tester's help. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]'); window.aitorTurn = () => window.ready() && document.querySelector('#battle[data-player="2"]'); window.p2 = sel => { document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="2"] ' + sel).focus(); ui.control('confirm', 2); }; window.bip = () => window.gerard.game.app.root.findByName('Bip'); window.bipAt = () => { const p = window.bip().getPosition(); return { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }; }; window.gerardDefends = () => { if (window.ready() && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-player="2"]')) document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"] [data-command="defend"] .command-trigger')?.click(); return !!window.aitorTurn(); };

steps.caption: Aitor's turn with Tecnópata: Bip floats by his shoulder and his dock is a drone's HUD
Bip up close: white shell, black glass screen with its cyan eye, antenna, side pods and the thruster's halo; Aitor's glasses turned HUD
Atacar asks for its target in the HUD's own panel (Tecnópata has no skills yet, so Habilidad is off)
Atacar: Bip pulls back, darts at the dog, rams it and bobs back; Aitor stays put pointing
Switching to another ánima: Bip comes apart into cyan nanites that stream into Aitor's chest
Back to Tecnópata: Bip comes out of Aitor as nanites, gathers by his shoulder and powers up
Bip back in place, Tecnópata's HUD on
